content: “Hessa gisho, Basili7eeli, Eliyaabinne Geeshsha Dunkaaniya keexana mela Goday hiillanne eratethi immida asa ubbay, Goday kiitidaysada ubbaba oothana” yaagis.
Imuwa Darotethaa
Musey Basili7eela, Eliyaaba, Goday dumma eratethi immidaysatanne ooso oothanaw koyiya ubbaa xeegidi, oosuwa doomana mela kiittis.
Enti, Isra7eele asay Geeshsha Dunkaaniya oothanaw ehida imo ubbaa Muse kushepe ekidosona. Qassi asay ba dosan immiya imota wonta wonta ehuwa aggibokona.
Yaatin, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya oothiya hiillanchoti banta oosuwa essidi, museko bidi,
“Asay, Goday kiitida oosuwas koshsheysafe aathidi eho bolla de7oosona” yaagidosona.
Musey, “Geeshsha Dunkaaniya keexanaw oonika immiyaba ehopo” yaagidi kiittin, asay eheysa aggaagidosona.
Enti ehida imotay ooso ubbaa oothi polanaw gididi palahees.
Geeshsha Dunkaane Oosuwa

Oosuwa ootheysatape hiillan aadheysati Geeshsha Dunkaaniya oothidosona. Enti iya al7o liinope, kaalosen ocha teera daaneysaninne zo7o qacinan alleeqisidi daddida tammu gesheta giigisidi, iya bolla kiruubeta misiliya sikidosona.
Magarajoti ubbay issi gina gididi, adussatethay laatamanne oyddu wadha, gompay oyddu wadha.
Ichashu gesheta issife gathidi sikidosona; qassi hanko attida ichashu geshetaka hessada oothidosona.
Issife gathidi sikida geshetape issi magarajuwas wursetha gaxan kaalose afilape oosetida sagaayota medhidosona. Qassi issife gathidi sikida hanko geshetape issuwa gaxanka hessada oothidosona.

Enti issife siketida koyro magarajuwa bolla koyro maaran kaalose afilape oosetida ishatamu sagaayota, hessadaka nam7antho magarajuwa bolla wursetha maaran, hanko sagaayota ginan, ishatamu sagaayota oothidosona.
Enti nam7u baggan de7iya gesheta gasethidi issino oothanaw worqafe ishatamu oykiya bessata medhidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bollara kammanaw tammanne issi gesheta deesha ikisepe daddidosona.
Tammanne issi gesheta adussatethaa laatamanne usupun wadha, gompaa oyddu wadha oothidi medhidosona.
Ichashu gesheta issi baggara, qassi usupun gesheta hanko baggara gathidi sikidosona.
Woli gathidi sikida geshetape wursetha magarajuwa macaran ishatamu sagaayota, qassi woli gathidi sikida hanko geshetape wursetha magarajuwa macaran ishatamu sagaayota medhidosona.
Nam7u baggara de7iya gesheta gasethidi issi kama oothanaw naase biratape ishatamu oykiya bessata medhidosona.
Dunkaaniya kammanaw zo7o qalamen yeggi kessida dorsa ite, qassi iya bollara kammanaw lo77o do7a ite giigisidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya tuuqeta soqala mithafe kessidosona.
Issi issi tuuqiya adussatethay tammu wadha, gompay issi wadhanne takadho.
Issi tuuqiya issuwara gasethanaw nam7u luhoti de7oosona. Geeshsha Dunkaaniya tuuqeta ubbaa hessada oothidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyas dugeha baggara laatamu tuuqeta medhidosona.
Issi issi tuuqetas nam7u toho medhidi, he tohota oythanaw oytamu luhota biratape giigisidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyas pudeha baggara laatamu tuuqeta medhidosona.
Issi issi tuuqetas nam7u toho medhidi, he tohota oythanaw oytamu luhota biratape giigisidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyas guye baggan, wuloha baggara usupun tuuqeta medhidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya guye baggan de7iya maazanetas nam7u tuuqeta giigisidosona.
He nam7u maazane tuuqeti xaphope xeera gakanaw oyketi bidosona. Nam7u maazaniyan de7iya nam7u tuuqeti hessada hanidi oosetidosona.
Hessa gisho, issi issi tuuqiyas garsan nam7u nam7u tohoti de7oosona. Hospun tuuqetas biratape oosetida tammanne usupun tohoti de7oosona.
Qassi enti soqala mithafe tammanne ichashu liyoota kessidosona. Ichashu liyooti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya issi bagga miyen,
qassi ichashu liyoota hanko bagga miyen, hessadaka ichashu liyoota guye baggara wuloha baggan wothidosona.
Tuuqetas miye baggara giddon de7iya liyoy, ha gaxape ya gaxa gakanaw kanthi keyana mela oothidosona.
Tuuqetanne liyoota worqan lanxidosona. Liyooti enta giddora kanthi aadhana mela worqa sagaayota tuuqetara oysethidosona.
Magarajuwa al7o liinope kaalosen, ocha teera daaneysaninne, zo7o qacinan alleeqisidi oothidosona. He magarajuwa bolla kiruube misileta sikidosona.
Magarajuwa kaqanaw oyddu tuussata soqala mithafe giigisidi, worqan lanxidosona. Yaatidi worqa sagaayota entas giigisidosona. Qassi tuussata essiya oyddu tohota bira biratape medhidosona.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya pengiyas al7o liinope kaalosen, ocha teera daaneysafenne zo7o qacinan alleeqisid magarajo giigisidosona.
Qassi iyaw kocati de7iya ichashu tuussata medhidi, entaw xeeranne tohuwa worqan lanxidosona. Tuussatas naase biratappe oosetidi ichashu tohota giigisidosona.
